CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  July 14, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Community Development Conference Room
  of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Corona, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael Daninger;
  Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Stanley Tsai

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – June 23, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the June 23, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the June 23, 2026, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve all Consent Agenda Items.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice Chairman
  Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Corona, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-044
  • 2912 West Ross Avenue
  • Applicant: John Oradan

  1
  07/14/2026
   •  Request: This is an application for new site improvements to an
  existing single-family residential property, including the construction
  of new front and side yard walls and the replacement of an existing
  concrete walkway.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Recused: Corona
  Absent:  Tsai

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-138
  • 1625 South Stoneman Avenue
  • Applicant: Mehrdad Tabar
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing
  duplex residence, including changes to existing windows, doors, and
  walls.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall revise the proposed color of the window
  trim, including any exposed bracing or roof supports, to be a
  Spanish tile brown color or similar shade, subject to review
  and approval by City Staff. In addition, revise the color swatch
  shown on the plans accordingly to reflect the approved color
  selection.
  2. The applicant shall revise Sheet D-1 to include only those
  details applicable to the proposed project and Design Review
  application. Such revisions shall include, but not be limited to,
  the removal or modification of Details 2, 5, 9, and 18.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Corona, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

  2
  07/14/2026
   ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-045
  • 523 South Electric Avenue
  • Applicant: Miguel Carpio
  • Request: This is an application for site improvements and the partial
  demolition and reconstruction of an exterior wall for an existing single-
  family residence, and a new front yard retaining wall, driveway, and
  gate.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Corona, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:31 P.M. to
  Tuesday, July 28, 2026, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Nora Corona
  Chairman
ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
